sights.address: Over the Kushiro River from JR Kushiro Station, Kushiro, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: One of Hokkaido's three famous bridges (1889, rebuilt 1976) with bronze statues of the four seasons — the stage for Kushiro's famous sunsets.

sights.n: Kamuiwakka Hot Falls, Shiretoko (カムイワッカ湯の滝)
sights.address: Kamuiwakka River, Shari, Shari District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A river heated by the active Mt Shiretoko-Iō — wade upstream through warm water to falls whose basins are natural hot baths; 'Water of the Gods' in Ainu.
